properties.name: animation-timeline
properties.description: Specifies the timeline used to control a CSS animation’s progress (scroll() / view() / named timelines).

properties.name: animation-range
properties.description: Shorthand for animation-range-start and animation-range-end along a timeline.

properties.name: animation-range-start
properties.description: Start of an animation’s attachment range on its timeline.

properties.name: animation-range-end
properties.description: End of an animation’s attachment range on its timeline.

properties.name: timeline-scope
properties.description: Controls whether named scroll/view timelines can be referenced outside their subtree.

properties.name: view-timeline-name
properties.description: Defines a named view progress timeline.

properties.name: view-timeline-axis
properties.description: Scroll axis for a view progress timeline.

properties.name: view-timeline-inset
properties.description: Insets that adjust when an element is considered in view for a view timeline.

properties.name: scroll-timeline-name
properties.description: Defines a named scroll progress timeline.

properties.name: scroll-timeline-axis
properties.description: Scroll axis for a scroll progress timeline.

properties.name: overlay
properties.description: Controls whether an element is rendered in the top layer (e.g. popovers/dialogs).

atDirectives.name: @starting-style
atDirectives.description: Defines starting style values for transitions on elements that are first rendered or leave display: none.

atDirectives.name: @container
atDirectives.description: Applies styles based on a containment context’s size or style queries.

pseudoClasses.name: popover-open
pseudoClasses.description: Matches a popover element that is in the showing state.
